description: Looks after one WhatsApp number, named by id. action sync refreshes the number’s state, quality rating and limits from Meta and returns the connection. action recheck_payment is for a person who added a payment method in Meta after a number was blocked for payment: it asks Meta again and returns the connection (adding the method itself happens in Meta’s own tools). action retry_verification takes the id of a phone number from Cosend (cnm_…) whose verification stopped, and asks WhatsApp for a new code on that same number, with no new purchase; it is allowed from the number’s preverify_retry_at, and the number shows verifying while Cosend waits up to 10 minutes for the code. Owners and admins for sync and retry_verification. Disconnecting a number is an owner’s or admin’s step in the Cosend dashboard.

action.description: sync reads the number’s state from Meta. recheck_payment asks Meta again after a payment method was added. retry_verification asks WhatsApp again for the code that verifies a phone number from Cosend.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: manage_number
title: Refresh or re-check a number
